caption:
# GUI Interface Description

## Top Bar

- **Left Side:**
  - "Activities" button
  - "Terminal" application icon with a dropdown menu

- **Center:**
  - Date and time display: "Oct 23 17:48"

- **Right Side:**
  - Notification bell icon
  - System status icons including:
    - Network connectivity
    - Sound/volume control
    - Power button

## Dropdown Menu (from Terminal)

- **Menu Items:**
  - "New Window"
  - "Preferences"
  - "Quit"

## Terminal Window

- **Window Title Bar:**
  - Username and hostname: "user@user-virtual-machine: ~"
  - Control buttons:
    - Search icon (magnifying glass)
    - Menu icon (three horizontal lines)
    - Minimize button (dash)
    - Maximize button (square)
    - Close button (X)

- **Terminal Content:**
  - Command prompt: "user@user-virtual-machine:~$"
  - Cursor (blinking underscore)

## Desktop Background

- Abstract geometric wallpaper with a gradient from deep purple to orange-red
- Central design element resembling a stylized feather or abstract swirl

## Left Dock (Application Launcher)

- **Application Icons (top to bottom):**
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird email client
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC media player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP image editor
  - File manager (folder icon)
  - Ubuntu Software (orange shopping bag)
  - Help (question mark)
  - Terminal (gray icon with command prompt)
  - Trash can

- **Bottom of Dock:**
  - Grid icon for application overview

## Desktop Icons

- **Bottom Right Corner:**
  - "Home" folder icon with label "Home"
